title: Beautiful MC Pack
description: It makes minecraft way more immersive and realistic, while still keeping a vanilla-like look
body:
# **Beautiful MC Pack**
This is a modpack wich enhances the player's experience, while still keeping a vanilla-like look!
## What does this add?
- It adds shaders, so the game looks really good
- It has a bunch of rescource packs.
- It adds new biomes
- It tweaks a couple of things
- It adds VR support

**It is highly recommended that you have a beefy computer for the best experience!**

**I hope you enjoy this modpack!**

**If it says there are updates available, then uhh... don't it kinda breaks it**
